[[File:Mithril scimitar detail.png|left|150px]]
The '''Mithril scimitar''' is a [[scimitar]] stronger than the [[black scimitar]]. Like all [[mithril weapons]], it requires 20 [[Attack]] to wield. It can only be used in combat. Players can make a mithril scimitar with the [[Smithing]] skill at level 55 using 2 [[mithril bar]]s, giving 100 [[experience]].
